consortium-banking.title: Consortium Banking and Multiple banking
consortium-banking.description1: We provide expert guidance on Consortium Banking and Multiple Banking to meet diverse funding needs. Consortium Banking is ideal for large-scale projects, where a group of banks collaborates to offer substantial financial support under a unified structure, reducing risk and ensuring streamlined coordination.
consortium-banking.description2: Multiple Banking allows businesses to work independently with multiple banks, offering flexibility and diverse credit lines to manage varied financial requirements. With Yenom Market’s expertise, businesses can navigate these complex arrangements with ease, ensuring seamless operations and sustainable financial growth.

features.title: Collaborative Lending
features.text: Multiple banks share the risk and funding requirements to support large-scale projects.

features.title: Large Funding Access
features.text: Ideal for businesses requiring significant capital investment through structured bank groups.

features.title: Centralized Monitoring
features.text: A lead bank coordinates between the borrower and other banks for simplified management.

features.title: Structured Processes
features.text: Involves a single agreement covering all participating banks, ensuring legal and operational clarity.

benefits: Streamlined communication with a single lead bank.

ma-advisory.title: M & A Advisory Solutions
ma-advisory.description1: Yenom Market offers specialized Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) Advisory Solutions to help businesses navigate the complex landscape of mergers, acquisitions, and corporate restructuring. Whether you’re looking to acquire, merge, or sell a business, our expert advisory team ensures that you make strategic, well-informed decisions to maximize value, mitigate risks, and achieve your business goals.
ma-advisory.description2: We provide expert M&A Advisory Solutions to guide businesses through the complexities of mergers, acquisitions, and corporate restructuring. Whether you’re looking to expand through acquisitions, merge for growth, or divest parts of your business, our team offers tailored strategies to maximize value and minimize risk.

features.title: EXPERTISE IN COMPLEX TRANSACTIONS

features.title: End-to-End Support

bridge-funding.title: Bridge Funding
bridge-funding.description1: Yenom Market offers Bridge Funding solutions to help businesses and individuals manage short-term financial needs during transitional periods. Whether you’re waiting for long-term financing or require immediate liquidity to close a critical deal, our bridge funding services provide the financial support you need to keep moving forward.
bridge-funding.description2: Our bridge funding solutions are designed to be flexible and fast, ensuring that your operations or investments never hit a roadblock while waiting for permanent capital.

features.title: Quick Access
features.text: Rapid processing to provide funds when time is of the essence.

features.title: Flexibility
features.text: Customized repayment plans tailored to your expected long-term funding source.

features.title: Continuity
features.text: Ensuring business projects stay on track while permanent financing is finalized.

sme-listings.title: SME Listings
sme-listings.description1: Yenom Market, we provide expert assistance in SME Listing to help small and medium enterprises (SMEs) unlock new growth opportunities, improve credibility, and access capital markets. Listing your business on a recognized stock exchange ensures transparency, enhances your brand value, and offers a platform for raising funds to fuel expansion.
sme-listings.description2: SME Listing refers to the process of listing small and medium enterprises on dedicated SME platforms of stock exchanges, such as the NSE Emerge or BSE SME platform. This allows SMEs to raise equity capital through public offerings and gain recognition in the financial ecosystem.

features.title: Access to Capital
features.text: Raise funds for expansion, working capital, or debt repayment through equity financing.

features.title: Enhanced Visibility
features.text: Improve brand value and market perception with the credibility of being a listed entity.

features.title: Improved Governance
features.text: Adopt transparent business practices and governance standards to attract investors.

features.title: Liquidity for Stakeholders

features.title: Growth Opportunities
features.text: Leverage the listing to explore joint ventures, mergers, and strategic partnerships.

ipo-advisory.title: IPO Advisory Services
ipo-advisory.description1: Yenom Market offers comprehensive IPO Advisory Services to guide businesses through the complex process of going public. Whether you’re looking to raise capital, enhance brand visibility, or expand your operations, our expert team provides strategic insights and hands-on support to ensure a successful Initial Public Offering (IPO).

Our post-IPO support ensures that your company remains compliant and successfully manages its new public status, positioning you for sustained growth and success in the market.

cibil.title: CIBIL
cibil.description1: We specialize in providing comprehensive CIBIL correction services for both individuals and companies. Our expert team works diligently to identify inaccuracies, rectify discrepancies, and enhance your credit score.
cibil.description2: Whether you’re aiming to improve personal credit or manage corporate credit profiles, our tailored solutions ensure optimal results. Our goal is to help you achieve a healthy credit profile for easier access to financial opportunities.
